## Summary

The F6 regression gate (AC3 of SA-0MSLK7XNZ00366YY) is enforced via the pytest suite (`tests/test_context_budget_gate.py`), but the `.githooks/pre-push` v2 hook containing the context-budget gate is NOT wired into the active hooks directory. The active `.git/hooks/pre-push` is a stale v1 (dated 2026-07-25, 1,038 B) containing only worklog sync, and `git config core.hooksPath` is unset. The audit (SA-0MSLK7XNZ00366YY, AC3 "adjusted") flagged this as the one enforcement gap: a push that regresses the context budget would not be blocked locally before reaching `dev`.

## Target outcome

Every `git push` to `dev` runs the context-budget gate (via the committed v2 pre-push hook), so future PRs cannot regress the ~54% context reduction without a developer actively bypassing the gate.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: The context-budget gate runs on every push in this repo — either by setting `core.hooksPath` to `.githooks/` or by installing `.githooks/pre-push` into `.git/hooks/pre-push`; verified by an end-to-end simulated push (gate present, hook fires).
- AC2: Worklog sync from the old v1 `.git/hooks/pre-push` is preserved (merged into v2 or still running) so switching hooks does not regress the sync behavior.
- AC3: `docs/dev/context-budget.md` enforcement section updated to describe the ACTIVE mechanism (hooksPath config or install command), including the `CONTEXT_BUDGET_SKIP=1` bypass and fail-open behavior when tooling is absent.
- AC4: Full test suite remains green (pytest + Node), including `tests/test_context_budget_gate.py` and the pre-push hook tests.

## Minimal implementation

- Choose mechanism: `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` (repo-level, recommended) or install the hook file.
- Verify v2 hook runs `measure_context.py --include-hidden --thresholds` on push and exits non-zero on threshold exceed.
- Confirm no double-run of worklog sync and no interference with `implement.py`/`ship` push flows.
- Update `docs/dev/context-budget.md` lines ~152-170 (enforcement instructions).

## Dependencies

- F6 (SA-0MSLK7XNZ00366YY) — gate hook file + thresholds already committed; this wires them into the active hooks.
- `.githooks/pre-push` v2 (already committed).

## Deliverables

- Active pre-push gate (hooksPath config or installed hook)
- Updated enforcement docs
- Green suite

## Notes

- Discovered during audit of SA-0MSLK7XNZ00366YY (AC3 variance, non-blocking).
- No CI exists in this repo; the pre-push hook is the intended local gate.
